description: This line plot illustrates the change in Word Error Rate (WER) across six epochs for six different Whisper fine-tuning methods, all configured with the “tiny” model type. The x-axis represents the number of epochs, ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis represents WER, scaled linearly from 30 to 70. The plot includes six distinct lines: a solid gray line with circle markers for “tiny AdaLoRA_int4”; a solid gray line with square markers for “tiny AdaLoRA_int8”; a dashed gray line with circle markers for “tiny int4”; a dashed gray line with square markers for “tiny int8”; a dotted gray line with triangle markers for “tiny”; and a dotted gray line with square markers for “tiny int8”. At epoch 0, WER values range from approximately 69 for “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” down to 29 for “tiny”. By epoch 6, all lines show a decline, with “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” reaching approximately 32, “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” reaching approximately 35, “tiny int4” reaching approximately 38, “tiny int8” reaching approximately 39, “tiny” remaining near 27, and “tiny int8” reaching approximately 37. The “tiny” method shows the lowest WER throughout, while “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” starts highest and declines steadily.
